body:
Founder real-time: "any debugging EXEs need to be added as independent
CICD builds with their own artifacts" (after being told to stop hand-
building and sending .exe files directly). New debug_build job in
tests.yml, producing its own separately-named artifact
(ShankPit_Debug_Builds_<run>_<sha>) on every push. Kept in tests.yml, not
release.yml -- verbose network logging is a troubleshooting tool, not
something a real player downloading a tagged Release needs. Builds via
real make targets (server/ea-windows with CFLAGS overridden), not a
fourth hand-duplicated gcc invocation -- this repo has 2 real documented
prior CI outages from exactly that anti-pattern.

Live-verified on REAL GitHub Actions (not just locally): both workflow
runs completed successfully, ShankPit_Debug_Builds_622_... artifact
confirmed produced (1,085,445 bytes) via the GitHub API.

Commit: SHANKPIT@4910748.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-53: real, independent debug-build CI job with its own artifacts
